_comment: Upstream Rosé Pine Dawn puts cursor/borders/selection/panel backgrounds on highlight_low/med/high (#f4ede8/#dfdad9/#cecacd), which sit at 1.05-1.48:1 against the #faf4ed base and are near-invisible in a terminal. Press each highlight step one notch darker, align text with the terminal foreground (#464261), and use the same #cfc6d9 selection tint as the Ghostty/kitty/Herdr themes. Color-role mapping is left to upstream.
